tasks.title: Execute transfer lane L5 (C4 anomalousness certificate plus controls) for the Anomalous curve

handoff.objective: Execute lane L5 (transfer, priority 1) of the frozen Anomalous audit plan (BATCH-7cb7f8 / TASK-20260824-8c11ab audit-plan.yaml) exactly as the plan states it. Produce certificate C4 for the published Anomalous tuple. C4 is C1 (a primality certificate for p) + C2 (base point G on the curve) + C3 (G != O and p*G = O) + the HD3 interval argument (p | #E and #E <= p + 1 + 2*sqrt(p) < 2p, hence #E = p and t = 1). Run L5's controls through the identical code path: CTRL-POS (the target itself: C4 must be produced), CTRL-NEG-1 (the quadratic twist, #E' = p + 2: C4 must NOT be producible, and a point G' on the twist must satisfy (p+2)*G' = O), CTRL-NULL (at least 20 independent random (a, b) at the SAME p, seeded and the seed recorded: C4 must not be producible on any, reported as a rate k/20), and CTRL-FAULT-1 (change one digit of one field of the valid certificate: the verifier must reject).
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the family's transfer-lane instrument fires on the one SafeCurves row whose transfer cell is expected to be false and stays silent on its parameter-matched twist and on same-prime random curves. Also, whether the published Anomalous tuple really satisfies #E = p, or whether the agreement between the retrieved p and l strings is a retrieval artefact (plan L5 explanations E1 versus E2).
constraints: READ THE AUDIT PLAN AS TEXT. audit-plan.yaml does not parse as YAML (parse error near line 210, recorded in DEC-20261001-9bb1b7). Do not repair, rewrite or re-serialize it. It is immutable.

SOURCE ROUTE, IN THIS ORDER, EACH ATTEMPT RECORDED. (1) Raw primary-host fetch of the four SafeCurves pages with curl into files inside write_scope, with sha256 recorded, never through a summarizing fetch tool. (2) If the host does not resolve or does not answer (at the 2026-10-01 capability check safecurves.cr.yp.to did not resolve), fetch a raw archived capture (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) and record capture URL, timestamp and sha256. (3) If neither works, use the capsule's retrieved digit strings for p, a, b, x1, y1, l, labelled `provenance: proxy_transcribed_unconfirmed`. Under every route, cite the exact source line or byte offset for each value used, or say there is none. Capsule conflict C-1 stays OPEN unless route (1) succeeds.

SELF-CHECK GATE. No digit string is used in any certificate until C2 (on-curve identity) passes for the tuple it belongs to. A failed C2 is a transcription finding about the source channel, NOT a mathematical result. Stop L5 and report it.

TWO INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATIONS FOR C3. Compute p*G once in pure Python (your own affine or Jacobian double-and-add) and once with Sage or PARI (ellmul / scalar multiplication). Record both results. Disagreement is an instrument fault and voids the lane.

PRIMALITY ROUTE DISCLOSED. C1 must be a real certificate: a Pocklington certificate as the plan specifies, or a PARI primecert ECPP certificate checked with primecertisvalid. Record which. A BPSW / Miller-Rabin outcome may be reported, but it must never be labelled a certificate (plan C1).

CTRL-DECAY IS NOT RUN, and CTRL-NEG-2 is optional. CTRL-DECAY requires implementing the additive transfer, which L5's stopping rule and capsule conflict C-4 forbid until a source paper has been read in full (DEC-20261001-9bb1b7 rationale). Record CTRL-DECAY as `deferred: not run` with that reason. CTRL-NEG-2 may be run only if it fits the budget, using a curve whose order is known by construction, per the plan.

DO NOT IMPLEMENT OR RUN ANY TRANSFER OR ATTACK (Smart / Semaev / Satoh-Araki). L5 certifies the PRECONDITION only. The strongest permitted sentence is "the documented precondition #E = p holds (or does not) for the stated tuple, certified".
No SafeCurves True/False comparison cell is emitted. Measured quantities are reported as measurements. Thresholds are not this task's question (capsule conflict C-2).

Stopping rule (plan L5): stop as soon as C4 is produced or refuted. The certificate budget is about 60 s of compute. Exceeding it is reported, never silently continued. A budget stop, timeout, DNS failure or missing dependency is an operational observation, never mathematical evidence (AGENTS.md core rule 5).

Make no statement that the Anomalous curve, or any curve, is safe, unsafe or vulnerable. Use only public parameters and locally generated controls. Never test, request, store or derive a live private key.
